findings.title: Heavy 4K files: decode only what we use
findings.text: 3840x2160 h264 High 4:2:2 (yuv422p10le) at ~147 Mbit/s, 29.97 fps. Converting every frame to BGR runs at ~34 fps on a laptop, so Part A asks the decoder to skip non-reference frames: the I-B-B-P GOP then yields every third frame (~10 fps) at ~5x realtime.

findings.title: A fixed signal cycle we can read from the lamps
findings.text: The main vehicle signal runs a fixed cycle whose length depends on the time of day (C3902 80 s, C3896 75 s, C3897 75 s, C3905 80 s): red ~39 s incl. red+amber, green ~33 s incl. flashing, amber ~3 s. Each lamp is located as the spot whose colour switches on and off over the video, which also works in harsh midday sun where the lit lamp is barely brighter than the housing; a bus hiding the head is marked unknown instead of guessed. This enables red_light, stop_line and congestion. We do not assume a fixed cycle: every video is read.

findings.title: Standstill on red is normal traffic
findings.text: Each red phase builds a queue of up to 27 stationary vehicles in the approach, and it clears within ~8 s of green. So congestion is only reported when the approach stays jammed on green, and queued vehicles never count as stopped_vehicle.

findings.title: Pedestrians cross everywhere
findings.text: Besides the three zebras, people cross diagonally between the islands and across the junction during the pedestrian phase, and bus passengers wait in the curb lane. Jaywalking therefore needs a margin from zebras and curbs and a bus-stop exemption; failure_to_yield only counts pedestrians on the roadway part of a zebra, near the vehicle.

findings.title: Lanes have one direction almost everywhere
findings.text: 548 grid cells have a lane direction shared by >85% of vehicles; inside the junction turns mix directions. The learned flow field drives wrong-way detection only in the coherent cells.

findings.title: Perspective changes object size ~4x
findings.text: A car on the far carriageway is ~60 px wide, one in the foreground ~250 px. Every distance used by the rules and by the risk model is expressed in object sizes, not pixels.

findings.title: Detections that are not road users
findings.text: Passengers are visible through bus windows and parked cars stand at the far curb all clip long. Persons inside vehicle boxes are dropped; stationary vehicles at the bus stop are exempt.
